description: This photograph captures an aerial view of a river system within a natural landscape. The main river channel, characterized by wide, light blue-grey water, meanders across the frame. Adjacent to the main channel, a distinct U-shaped oxbow lake with darker water is visible, clearly separated by an area of dense green vegetation. The surrounding land cover consists predominantly of various shades of green vegetation, including riparian growth and more distant forested hills. A rocky outcrop is visible in the bottom-left foreground, indicating the elevated vantage point from which the photograph was taken. A thin, light-coloured linear feature, possibly a track or road, is visible near the bottom edge, running alongside the rocky foreground. This image illustrates a seasonally connected water course or oxbow lake, as described in the document's definition for category "8.1.3 Seasonally connected water courses (oxbows)".
